notes.zh: 触发：游戏开始后由开局事件闸门 country.900 抽取（events/game_start.txt:15 在460±60天后触发；events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 为按权重的随机列表，四条开局故事互斥，另有69%什么都不发生）。权重10：灵性主义者×2、物质主义者×0.5，“年轻”起源或热衷探索者为0；非集群意识、人类玩家、非游牧（country_events_1.txt:2267-2274）。选项b：花费125团结买下被劫持的舰队并结束事件链，另有20%在约360天后得到 country.225（旗舰赠予）。
notes.en: Trigger: After game start the starting-event gate country.900 draws it (events/game_start.txt:15 fires it after 460±60 days; events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 is a weighted random list: the four opening stories are mutually exclusive and 69% of the weight is "nothing happens"). Weight 10: spiritualists x2, materialists x0.5, 0 for "young" origins or eager explorers; non-gestalt, human player, not nomadic (country_events_1.txt:2267-2274). Option b pays 125 unity for the hijacked fleet and ends the chain, with a 20% chance of country.225 (flagship gifted) after about 360 days.
